channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened
item.description: The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

item.title: 4 ways to avoid getting ripped off, according to a pricing expert
item.description: Companies have changed the way they price their products — and shoppers are getting deliberately overcharged. Here are steps you can take to ensure you are getting the best deal.

item.title: Morning news brief
item.description: Five men arrested on terror charges near U.K. air base released on bail, Trump administration rolls back fuel efficiency standards for new vehicles, prosecutors reopen Cornell fraternity rape case.

item.title: News organizations ask court to bar White House enforcement of access ban
item.description: Three news outlets that President Trump banished from White House grounds asked a federal court to block the ban until the case is resolved.

item.title: The Senate passes the Protect College Sports Act, but the bill's future is unclear
item.description: The bill's supporters, which include the NCAA, say it will tame what they call a "Wild West" era of college sports as litigation chips away at long-held rules around eligibility, transfers and pay.

item.title: Trump's immigration push has largely spared farms. Idaho dairymen worry it won't last.
item.description: America's farms have largely escaped the president's aggressive immigration crackdown. But as ICE sweeps continue across the nation, farmers are uneasy because many still can't find enough workers.

item.title: Real winner of Xi summit revealed as Trump looks to usher in new era with China
item.description: Trump's red-carpet welcome for Xi Jinping yielded fentanyl and tariff progress, but critical minerals, cyber threats and Taiwan remain unresolved.

item.title: Mass migration eroding Western sovereignty, immigration expert warns
item.description: President Donald Trump challenged the United Nations General Assembly on mass migration, but an expert says the sovereignty crisis runs deeper.

item.title: Could Trump revoke Ilhan Omar's citizenship for alleged brother marriage? Ex federal prosecutor breaks it down
item.description: DHS is conducting a criminal investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar, but a former federal prosecutor warns of "very high bars" to prove marriage fraud.

item.title: Socialist jeweler who called US a 's---hole' teams up with top Dem Senate hopefuls
item.description: Alexis Bittar, who called America a "s---hole" and the American flag a symbol of aggression, hosts a fundraiser in NYC supporting Democratic Party candidates for U.S. Senate.

item.title: Liz Peek: America — don’t vote for crazy over normal in the midterms
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed's Michigan senate race and the Iran war fuel a heated midterm debate over Democrats, affordability and Trump's economic record.

item.title: MORNING GLORY: President Trump and the American military have beaten Iran
item.description: Strait of Hormuz control has shifted as ADNOC, Saudi Aramco, Kuwait, Qatar and Iraq use a shuttle system to move oil via the Oman Lane under United States military protection.

item.title: The AI revolution will go wherever there's electricity — and China knows it
item.description: President Donald Trump's solar and battery storage push aims to secure energy dominance and fuel the AI data centers America needs to outpace China.

item.title: Senate passes Protect College Sports Act with decisive vote
item.description: The Protect College Sports Act, which would set national rules for NIL deals, the transfer portal and more, was passed by the Senate on Monday night.

item.title: See how a record El Niño has transformed Hawaii’s hurricane season
item.description: Three hurricanes in the past month have given Hawaii a taste of what a record-setting El Niño will bring to many states this year.

item.title: Trump says new fuel economy rules will cut car prices. Analysts are doubtful.
item.description: In rolling back fuel efficiency standards, the administration said the average new vehicle price in 2031 should be reduced by $1,300.

item.title: Education Department officially scraps Biden-era Title IX rules
item.description: The new regulations mark a return to rules from the first Trump administration.

item.title: Want advice on financing college? Sign up for the Paying for College 101 Newsletter.
item.description: In this six-part guide, reporter Danielle Douglas-Gabriel helps you navigate the complex maze of paying for higher education.

item.title: At every turn, Trump’s ideas for aiding U.S. consumers run into resistance
item.description: From beef to diesel, White House efforts to bring down prices — the top concern among midterm voters — have failed so far to pan out.

item.title: GOP senator blocks bill to stop Trump from demolishing Kennedy Center
item.description: The bipartisan effort to ban the demolition of presidential memorials was thwarted in the Senate by an objection from Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah).
